label: crypt
evidence: Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 (Massoni-Badosa et al., 2024) annotates an epithelial 'Crypt'/'Crypt (epithelial cell)' cluster. In the atlas text the epithelial compartment comprises three keratinocyte-overlapping clusters (one being FDCSP epithelium) representing the tonsillar surface and crypt epithelium. The literature (Arambula et al., 2021; Crowell et al., 2025; Raju et al., 2012) identifies the tonsillar crypt lining as reticulated crypt epithelium / lymphoepithelium: a specialized antigen-sampling compartment lined by simple/non-keratinizing epithelium interspersed with lymphocytes, with discontinuous basement membrane, containing M (microfold) cells (SPIB/MARCKSL1) and simple-epithelial keratins K8/K18/K19.
